purpose: Define invite-only group messaging with explicit group identity, immutable owner identity and bounded participant membership over P2P messaging semantics.

topics.name: Group Messaging
topics.purpose: Define invite-only group messaging with explicit group identity, immutable owner identity and bounded participant membership over P2P messaging semantics.

semantics.group_rule: Group has explicit stable semantic identity.
semantics.owner_rule: Group owner identity is immutable for the lifetime of the group under the current model.
semantics.transport_rule: Group messaging may use peer-to-peer transport arrangements but transport topology does not redefine group identity.
semantics.payload_rule: Group messages are inert payloads scoped to the group conversation.
semantics.membership_visibility_rule: Current participant membership is explicitly readable by authorized group participants.
semantics.ui_rule: Commands such as /msg users are client projections over canonical/current group membership state.

invariants.rule: Messaging identity, conversation state, throttling, group governance and transport semantics remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: group has no stable semantic identity
membership inferred from transport topology only
non-member receives group payload without explicit policy
UI participant list becomes membership authority

prose.summary: Define invite-only group messaging with explicit group identity, immutable owner identity and bounded participant membership over P2P messaging semantics.
